what_it_does: HuMoniX is a specialized processor for generating realistic human motion sequences from text descriptions using diffusion models. The key insight is that in text-to-motion generation, much of the computation is redundant: successive denoising iterations often produce nearly identical updates to the same joint positions, and similar joints across consecutive animation frames can share intermediate calculations. HuMoniX exploits both forms of redundancy through hardware and software co-design, skipping unnecessary computations and reusing partial results, achieving 57.3 frames per second at 12.8 trillion floating-point operations per watt.
